chunks: We have sent it down with truth, and with truth has (the Qur'an) come down. And We have sent you only to give good news and to warn.

key_terms.أَنزَلْنَاهُ: We have sent it down (referring to the Quran)

ai.seo_question: What is the primary purpose of the Prophet's mission according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the dual mention of 'truth' (al-Haqq) underscores the Quran's objective reality and the Prophet's (SAWW) role as the perfect exemplar of divine guidance, bridging the gap between revelation and human understanding. This verse highlights the dual nature of prophethood as both a mercy (mubashshir) and a warning (nadhir), a concept central to the Imamate's function in guiding the community through both spiritual glad tidings and moral accountability.
